title: Ring models round 1: 12 wild worn rings, hero mesh + voxel twin (12)
desc: J: "new ring models refined as good of a model I can currently get in blender 12 variations (past ones have all been weak)". Picked: smooth hero model + its 1/4 px voxel twin per take, a Wilder lineup, hero + turntable + first person. Turntable: hero left, voxel twin right. First person: the jar's placement, fist bent back 50. Hero close-ups: Cam <code> hero in the .blend.
